title: Hilton Expands LXR Hotels & Resorts in Costa Rica with Maravé Manuel Antonio Signing
summary: Hilton today announced the signing of Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts, marking the brand’s upcoming debut in Costa Rica.

**MANUEL ANTONIO, Costa Rica and MIAMI –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the signing of Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts, marking the brand’s upcoming debut in Costa Rica and a significant step in Hilton’s continued luxury expansion across the Caribbean and Latin America. Located on a nearly 40-acre estate of rare, titled beachfront that descends from rainforest ridge to 650 feet of Pacific beachfront, the resort will blend 173 accommodations, including dedicated hotel guest rooms, suites and fully furnished branded residences, with sweeping views of the ocean, surrounding mountains and rainforest canopy. The property is expected to open in 2029.


With its blend of biodiversity, dramatic coastline and established appeal among luxury travelers, Manuel Antonio is a natural fit for LXR Hotels & Resorts, Hilton’s curated collection of independent, spirited luxury properties known for distinctive character, bespoke service and a deep connection to some of the world’s most alluring destinations. The project’s residential component will further expand Hilton’s branded residential presence in sought-after resort markets, bringing Hilton’s global hospitality standards to a destination designed to feel unmistakably rooted in Costa Rica.


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Exterior Ariel View Rendering


“Costa Rica represents a key growth market for Hilton, with strong demand for high-end, nature-immersed travel,” said Pablo Maturana, vice president, Development, Architecture, Design and Construction, Caribbean and Latin America, Hilton. “With Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts, we are introducing a distinctive luxury retreat that will bring LXR’s destination-led approach to life through highly personalized service, immersive cultural connection and one-of-a-kind experiences inspired by the spirit of Manuel Antonio.”


“We are thrilled to partner with Hilton to bring LXR Hotels & Resorts to Manuel Antonio,” said Bruce Begia, president, Ocean Cove MA Development One S.A. “This project is designed to create a unique destination that connects guests with Costa Rica’s natural environment while delivering exceptional luxury and service.”


Minutes from Manuel Antonio National Park, Costa Rica’s most visited national park, the resort will welcome guests and residents to one of the country’s most celebrated coastal ecosystems.


## Luxury accommodations and branded residences designed for immersion


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Hotel Rendering


The seven-story resort will feature 57 accommodations, including 42 ocean-view guest rooms designed to immerse guests and owners in the surrounding rainforest, mountains and coastline and 15 private bungalows set on the natural hillside, each offering a secluded sanctuary with its own plunge pool and sweeping sunset views of the Pacific.


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Residences will also feature 116 fully furnished luxury residences overlooking the Pacific Ocean. As the first LXR Residences in Latin America, the community offers one of Costa Rica’s few opportunities to own branded luxury homes. The development includes 66 private villas, 46 oceanfront condominiums and four penthouses.


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Residences - Exterior View Rendering


Thoughtfully designed by renowned Costa Rican firm Carazo Arquitectura the resort follows the region’s natural topography and preserves its lush greenery, creating a private, expansive retreat where each structure feels immersed in the landscape rather than set apart from it. Engineered to be sustainable and mindful of the surrounding rainforest ecosystem, the resort is expected to include the largest mass timber structure in Costa Rica, with each key positioned to capture a clear line of sight to the Pacific. Interiors by Chicago-based Curioso feature natural stone, warm wood finishes and expansive walls of glass that blur the line between indoor and outdoor living.


> “Maravé stood out for its extraordinary location, thoughtful design and authentic connection to Manuel Antonio’s rainforest and Pacific coastline.”
>
>
> Dino Michael
>

> Global Category Head, Hilton Luxury Brands


“Maravé stood out for its extraordinary location, thoughtful design and authentic connection to Manuel Antonio’s rainforest and Pacific coastline,” said Dino Michael, global category head, Hilton Luxury Brands. “It brings together everything we look for in an LXR property destination: distinctive character, a sense of place and experiences that invite homeowners to embrace adventure, nature and uncompromising luxury.”


## Amenities designed to elevate the stay


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Residences - Exterior Villa Pool Rendering


Maravé Manuel Antonio will offer a range of amenities that connect guests and residents with the natural beauty, local culture and coastal setting of Manuel Antonio.


Wellness, culinary and leisure experiences will move naturally with the rhythm of the Pacific, from restorative treatments and active days outdoors to coffee in the morning, open-air dining, sunset cocktails and unhurried time by the water.


With direct access to the resort’s beachfront, the Beach Club will serve as the resort’s social hub, bringing together multiple pool environments, oceanfront dining, signature bars, beach and pool cabanas, poolside lounge areas with attentive service and concierge support from morning through evening.


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Beach Club Aerial Rendering


Signature restaurants will include two chef-led venues showcasing Costa Rican and international culinary perspectives, drawing on Manuel Antonio’s sea-to-table sourcing and the rainforest’s heritage ingredients. All-day and poolside service will feature elevated resort cuisine with effortless indoor-outdoor dining from breakfast to late evening.


The MARAVÉ Speakeasy Bar will offer an intimate experience and a must-see setting envisioned as the resort’s best-kept secret, with reserved seating priority access for residence owners and guests. The curated bar program will feature spirit-forward classics, native Costa Rican botanicals and a tightly edited late-night menu.


Guests and residents will also have access to an expansive spa and wellness sanctuary designed to restore body and mind in close connection with the surrounding nature, along with a premier fitness center offering strength, mobility and recovery facilities with jungle and sea views.


Family-friendly programming will include a dedicated youth and activity club with indoor and outdoor experiences timed to the rhythm of resort life.


## A future of luxury for the Caribbean and Latin America


Hilton is expanding at record pace across the Caribbean and Latin America, with more than 315 hotels in more than 35 countries and territories. In Latin America, the luxury and lifestyle portfolio spans over 100 hotels, including boutique properties added through a strategic partnership with Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH). Additionally, there are more than 150 hotels in the pipeline, the largest in its history for the region, including 50 in the luxury and lifestyle categories.


Last year’s highly anticipated opening of Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique marked the brand’s debut in the country, while the announcement of Waldorf Astoria Turks and Caicos Dellis Cay, set to open in 2028, further underscores Waldorf Astoria’s continued momentum across the region. In Mexico, Hilton plans to debut Waldorf Astoria San Miguel de Allende in 2027, followed by Conrad Los Cabos in 2028.


Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts will offer guests the benefits of[Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/) , the award-winning guest-loyalty program for Hilton's distinct hotel brands.


Residence owners will also receive Hilton Honors Diamond status and exclusive benefits throughout Hilton's global luxury portfolio. Sales are expected to launch in Fall 2026, with construction anticipated for completion in late 2028. For more information on the residential offering at Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Hotels & Resorts, please visit[Maravé Manuel Antonio, LXR Residences](https://www.maraveresidences.com/en/) .


For additional Hilton development news, please visit[stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/) .

Found in the world's most alluring destinations, each hand-selected property boasts its own storied past and is infused with the essence of its distinctive locale, providing a luxurious hub for the discerning adventurer. The portfolio delivers elevated offerings from estate homes in resort settings to private residences in iconic urban cities, rooted in a philosophy of care and attention to the resident experience across categories, with commercial success across all market segments, from luxury to lifestyle and beyond. With 13 world-class brands spanning over 40 properties operating globally, and more than 50 properties in development, Branded Residential by Hilton brings Hilton’s century of influence and expertise in global hospitality to a culturally-savvy, design-forward and diverse, best-in-class portfolio.
